validity.researcher_notes: Ru.wikipedia's GTS-Russia table states Yamburg-Povolzhye is 2730 km, a 25 km (0.9%) shorter figure than GEM's recorded 2755.00 km. This is the SAME source that gives Diameter=1420mm and Start=1990, both of which match GEM's recorded values exactly on this row, so the source is unambiguously describing this exact pipeline, not a mismatch of pipelines. The gap is small enough (comparable to the batch's own worked within-rounding examples) to plausibly reflect a routing-length-measurement convention difference (e.g. main-trunk pipe length vs full corridor including lateral/tie-in sections) rather than a factual conflict, and is corroborated as REFS_ADDED per rule 4(e) rather than left unsourced. No second independent source giving a length figure was found (energybase.ru's page is geo-blocked with no Wayback snapshot). Recommend leaving GEM's 2755.00 as-is; this is a documented discrepancy, not a confirmed error, and a future pass with access to energybase.ru or another Russian pipeline-spec database could resolve it further.

validity.recommendation: Do not use gem.wiki's cited earchive.tpu.ru/bitstream/11683/24724/1/TPU138412.pdf as a source for P3506 in any output (we never cite gem.wiki anyway, but flagging for GEM's own wiki-citation hygiene). See cross_row_leads for where this PDF actually belongs.
validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki's citation list for Yamburg-Volga_Region_Gas_Pipeline includes earchive.tpu.ru/bitstream/11683/24724/1/TPU138412.pdf. Downloaded and extracted the PDF locally (pdftotext -layout, per escalation procedure) rather than trusting the fetch tool's rendering. The document is a 2016 Tomsk Polytechnic University bachelor's thesis titled 'Технология очистки магистрального газопровода <<Уренгой – Центр 2>> в условиях Крайнего Севера' (Cleaning technology for the Urengoy-Center 2 trunk gas pipeline) -- i.e. it is ABOUT Urengoy-Center 2, a different pipeline entirely (GEM ProjectIDs P3507/P5612, 'Urengoy-Center Gas Pipeline', segments I/II), not Yamburg-Volga Region. The thesis does contain one incidental design-spec table listing 'Ямбург-Поволжье' alongside eight other parallel-corridor lines (all sharing the same generic per-section design parameters: Ду1400мм, 89 млн.м3/сутки, ~97-102 km compressor-station spacing) as background/context for its Urengoy-Center-2-specific cleaning-technology study -- this is NOT substantive coverage of Yamburg-Povolzhye itself (it never discusses this pipeline's own history, construction, or operations) and does not pass the 'must NAME the pipeline with real content' bar for a citable ref here. This is a wiki mis-citation, not a data point about P3506; not used in any fill above.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Most recent line-specific evidence found is dated 2019-05-06 (Interfax report of a depressurization/fire on 'МГ Ямбург-Поволжье'), well before the sheet's 2023-08-10 LastUpdated -- does not itself satisfy the annual-update preference for post-LastUpdated evidence. Targeted follow-up search for 2024-2025 coverage naming 'Ямбург-Поволжье' or 'Ямбург-Поволжье' specifically (Russian-language) returned only generic Gazprom Transgaz Volgograd annual-summary pages (e.g. volgograd-tr.gazprom.ru's 2024 results announcement, fetched via Wayback after the live gazprom.ru host timed out) that report REGION-WIDE throughput totals (91.9 bcm/y across Volgograd/Rostov/Voronezh Oblasts) without naming this or any individual pipeline -- an aggregate figure, not a name-matching ref for this row (aggregate-vs-segment rule), so not cited above. No source anywhere (2019 incident coverage, 2024-2025 operator annual summaries, industry directories) suggests decommissioning, mothballing, or replacement of this line. Per the calibration rule, absence of pipeline-specific news for a mature 1990-commissioned Gazprom trunk is the expected quiet-operations pattern for an asset generating no further incidents, not a staleness signal. Confirm operating, at medium tier given the 2019 evidence-recency gap.

cross_row_leads.note: This PDF is gem.wiki-cited on P3506 (Yamburg-Volga Region Gas Pipeline) but is actually a 2016 Tomsk Polytechnic University bachelor's thesis specifically about 'Уренгой – Центр 2' (Urengoy-Center 2) cleaning technology -- almost certainly a wiki mis-citation belonging on Urengoy-Center Gas Pipeline segment II (P5612, SegmentName 'II', per the sheet's Urengoy-Center rows P3507/P5612) rather than P3506. Not used as a ref for P3506 in this shard (see validity concern misattributed_ref). If GEM's wiki citation for P3506 is ever revisited, this URL should likely move to P5612 instead; we do not edit gem.wiki ourselves (standing rule).
